login.title: Channel ƒe Dɔwɔhatiwo ƒe Geɖe
login.welcome: Míexɔ wò nyuie! De asi ete be nàkpɔ wò ŋgɔdonyawo gbɔ.
login.heroTitle: Dzi wò anyigba kple xɔ ƒe asitsatsa ɖe edzi kple ŋgɔdonya ɖesiaɖe si nàtsɔ vɛ
login.heroIntro: Agbo ɖeka si dzi nàto aŋlɔ asisiwo ŋkɔ ɖe xɔtulawo gbɔ, adzra wò ŋgɔdonyawo ƒe kafukafu ɖo eye nàkplɔ wo ɖo vaseɖe agbalẽŋɔŋlɔ dzi.

register.title: Ŋlɔ ŋkɔ kplɔlawo le sɛkɛnd ʋɛ aɖewo ko me
register.text: Tsɔ wò asisi kple dɔ si me wotsɔ ɖe le la ɖo ɖa.

protect.title: Ametakpɔkpɔ zi eve
protect.text: Wò lead nɔa tɔwò me hena ametakpɔkpɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia, eyata ame bubu aɖeke mate ŋu abia asisi ma ke o.

track.title: Track afɔɖeɖe ɖesiaɖe
track.text: Kpɔ ŋgɔdola ɖesiaɖe ƒe nɔnɔme kple ŋutinya bliboa, tso kadodo gbãtɔ dzi va ɖo agbalẽŋɔŋlɔ dzi.

handover.title: Woxɔa kafukafu le agbalẽŋɔŋlɔ me
handover.text: Ne asisi aɖe le agbalẽ ŋlɔm la, wotsɔa ŋgɔdonya la dea asi na xɔtula la eye wòŋlɔa agbalẽ ɖi be ènye hadɔwɔla si tso teƒea.

login.secure: Dedienɔnɔ ƒe gege ɖe eme - wò asisiwo ƒe nyatakakawo nɔa adzame
login.builderLink: De asi xɔtula ƒe agbo nu

signup.title: Channel Partner ƒe Ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ
signup.intro: Wɔ wò akɔnta be nàdze wò ŋutɔ wò ŋgɔdonyawo ŋɔŋlɔ kple wo dzi kpɔkpɔ gɔme.
